int_name: W BERKS ST & N ETTING ST

result.summary: The residential street features sidewalks on both sides but lacks essential crossing infrastructure at the intersection. No marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control signals are visible, creating a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at the intersection increases pedestrian exposure and reduces driver awareness.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped transitions makes the crossing inaccessible for people with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the silver car

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all four corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: This residential one-way street lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure on one side, with overgrown vegetation and debris obstructing the path. There are no marked crosswalks or traffic control devices visible to protect pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Illegal Dumping and Debris
hazards.description: Large items and trash block the informal walkway on the right side of the street, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground near the utility pole

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, providing no separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at the intersection increases risk for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a standard paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility crosswalks and install ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection.

interventions.title: Debris Removal and Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear the illegal dumping and trim overgrown vegetation to improve sightlines and walkway accessibility.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with row houses and a narrow sidewalk in fair condition. A 'Do Not Enter' sign is visible, but the right side of the image is heavily obscured by blurring, limiting the overall assessment.

hazards.name: Uneven sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked and uneven, creating a trip hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the buildings.

hazards.name: Limited visibility at building corner
hazards.description: The building corner limits sightlines between pedestrians and any potential traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left at the vine-covered building.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk to improve safety and accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility for all road users at night.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of residential row houses with wide, well-maintained sidewalks but lacks any formal crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices visible at the immediate intersection, creating accessibility and safety gaps.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk terminates at a vertical curb at the corner, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility impairments or strollers.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: The lack of painted crosswalks fails to alert drivers to potential pedestrian activity at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area adjacent to the sidewalk corner

hazards.name: Lack of traffic control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow at the intersection.
